clue.text: He cuts open a girl's form for cosmetic effects

definitions.text: He cuts open a girl's form for cosmetic effects

parts.words: He cuts open a girl's form for cosmetic effects
parts.note: a description of a professional who operates on people's bodies to improve their looks, with a sly sinister tone

explanation.surface: Sounds like a menacing figure slicing into a young woman, but it is a description of a cosmetic doctor's work.

parts.note: an inside job is one carried out secretly by someone within an organisation

clue.text: One in Paris pronounced completely blasphemous

parts.note: un is French for one

clue.text: Knight who thanked heaven for little girls

clue.text: His dozen may be unlucky for some

definitions.text: His dozen may be unlucky for some

parts.words: His dozen may be unlucky for some
parts.note: a tradesman whose dozen is thirteen loaves; unlucky for some is the bingo call for thirteen

explanation.surface: A man whose twelve somehow brings bad luck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unlucky for some' is the British bingo call for number 13, and a baker's dozen is 13.
explanation.definitionFit: Traditionally the bread seller added a thirteenth loaf to twelve, hence the thirteen-count dozen.
